---
title: Developer installation
description: Install the FreeCampus Math package or configure a contributor environment.
page_type: developer
---

Learners can use the website and generated Colab lessons without configuring a
local contributor environment.

## Install the package

```bash
python -m pip install freecampus-math
```

The distribution is `freecampus-math`; the Python import is `fcmath`.

```python
import fcmath
print(fcmath.__version__)
```

## Contributor environment

```bash
conda env create -f conda/dev.yaml
conda activate fcmath
poetry config virtualenvs.create false
poetry install --extras "dev"
```

Run the full local gate with `makim all.ci`. Curriculum-only edits can start
with `makim curriculum.validate` and a scoped Quarto render.
